# odinex_load_balancer_types (Data Source)

Lists all load balancer types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_load_balancer_types" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of all load balancer types.
- `load_balancer_types` (List of Object) All load balancer types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancer_types))
- `names` (List of String) Names of all load balancer types.

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancer_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancer_types`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `max_connections` (Number)
- `max_services` (Number)
- `max_targets` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `prices` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--load_balancer_types--prices))

<a id="nestedobjatt--load_balancer_types--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancer_types.prices`

- `price_hourly_gross` (String)
